placements.role: Operates the La Rochelle plant in France, one of the largest rare-earth separation plants outside China, targeting industrial-scale dysprosium and terbium separation by September 2026.

role_evidence.claim: Solvay's mapping placement evidence describes this role.
role_evidence.source_name: Solvay, press release: Solvay and Viridis sign letter of intent (LOI) for rare earth materials sourcing

mapping_audit.basis: rare-earth-separation mapping has no universe-audit block yet; census remains ACTIVE, not COMPLETE.

business_summary: Solvay operates the La Rochelle plant in France, described as one of the largest rare-earth separation plants outside China and one of the few sites worldwide capable of processing all rare-earth elements at industrial scale, targeting industrial-scale dysprosium and terbium separation by September 2026. FY2025 revenue (vendor-normalized, EUR) was 4,746,000,000, down 7.5% from 5,130,000,000 in FY2024, with net income falling sharply to 30,000,000 from 223,000,000, though operating cash flow improved to 682,000,000 from 615,000,000.

exposure_summary.narrative: SOLB carries one ACTIVE placement on this chain, the money-corner, UNDISCOVERED rare-earth-separation-capacity link, via La Rochelle; Solvay is a large diversified chemicals group and rare-earth separation is one specialty business line within it, not the whole company.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Solvay is a large diversified chemicals group; the yfinance-normalized statements fetched this run do not break out a separate rare-earth/La Rochelle revenue percentage.

latest_fy.basis: Total revenue (EUR, vendor-normalized) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements vendor block; not a filing quote.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: One-year revenue growth computed as (4746000000/5130000000)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, fiscal year ended 2024-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 (both EUR, vendor-normalized); the field name suggests a 3-year window but only a 1-year change is computed here.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 476,000,000 divided by revenue 4,746,000,000, both EUR (vendor-normalized) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 682,000,000 divided by net income 30,000,000, both EUR (vendor-normalized) for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31. Net income was depressed by non-operating items relative to cash generation.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt (total_debt 2,131,000,000 less cash 536,000,000 = 1,595,000,000) divided by EBITDA (operating income 476,000,000 plus depreciation 404,000,000 = 880,000,000), both EUR (vendor-normalized) at/for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 3 of 9, state WEAK, computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/SOLB-BR.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -3.268 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/SOLB-BR.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization (EUR) 2693442272.84 = shares outstanding 104,477,978 (fiscal year ended 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 25.78 (yfinance Euronext Brussels price, EUR, 2026-09-14); statement and trading currency both EUR, no mixing.

price_to_sales.basis: Market cap 2693442272.84 divided by FY2025 revenue 4,746,000,000, both EUR.

implied_fcf_cagr.source_name: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, read from data/market/SOLB-BR.json quality.reverse_dcf (source yfinance-statements)
implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 4,288,442,272.84 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 462,000,000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements vendor statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.source_name: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, read from data/market/SOLB-BR.json quality.reverse_dcf (source yfinance-statements)
horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': -0.0927, '7': -0.0664, '10': -0.0466}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: SOLB sits on a link scored UNDISCOVERED (rare-earth-separation-capacity), but this profile cannot corroborate that read with issuer-level positioning data: no pcs block exists in data/market/SOLB-BR.json, and Solvay's PCS as a large diversified chemicals name would in any case reflect the whole company, not just La Rochelle.
